feature: Suspect dataclass, InvestigationExitReason enum, revised InvestigationResult
problem: V4.2 Phase 2 needs typed suspects (not raw dicts), explicit exit reasons, and backward-compatible adapters for existing eval infrastructure.
proposed_solution: Add Suspect, InvestigationExitReason to result.py. Suspect.to_dict() produces the dict shape consumed by D3/D6 scoring. InvestigationResult gets exit_reason and elapsed_s fields. Suspects type stays list[dict] until p16-6 integration.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Suspect dataclass has all 7 fields (commit_id, rank, confidence, mechanism, evidence_quotes, phase, tools_used) with to_dict() and from_dict()
AC2: InvestigationExitReason enum has all 9 values from V4.2 ADR
AC3: Suspect.to_dict() output matches existing dict shape — keys commit_id, confidence, mechanism, evidence_quotes present
AC4: InvestigationResult has exit_reason (default None) and elapsed_s (default 0.0) fields, backward-compatible with existing usage
AC5: Round-trip serde: Suspect.from_dict(s.to_dict()) == s for representative instance
AC6: All existing tests pass without modification (backward compat)
edge_cases: EC1: Suspect with empty evidence_quotes list serializes correctly
EC2: InvestigationExitReason values are string-compatible (str(reason) works for trace output)
verification_method: pytest tests/ -x — all existing tests pass + new tests for Suspect, ExitReason, adapter shape
